g.text: First listed recording per family; R1 uses an unresolved frozen tracker proxy, not physical tag/body GT.
Other XY marker colors = observed tag error; R5 gyro-input validation remains OPEN. Lines identify
methods. No alignment. R3 TEST after 16.679 s; observed gaps broken, censored tracks absent. Large
excursions keep full scale with GT-neighborhood insets.
